name: Ōno (Fukui, Japan)
description: A maroon field charged at the centre with the Ōno city emblem in white: a five-pointed star-like device enclosing a ring.
history: Municipal flag of Ōno, a city in Fukui Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 July 1954.

features.role: Ōno city emblem — a five-pointed star-like device enclosing a ring
